[[Cinnabar Gym]] }} '''Purrrr-sian''' (Japanese: '''VS ペルシアン''' ''VS Persian'') is the 47th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the seventh chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} In an unknown barren location, {{adv|Blue}} is waiting just as his {{p|Pidgeot}} returns with a message in its talons. Thanking his Pokémon, Blue opens the letter from his grandfather, {{adv|Professor Oak}}, and silently pores over its contents. Back in [[Celadon City]], {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} is faced with {{adv|Yellow}}'s demands for [[Pika]], but simply sneers a challenge for Yellow to take Pika back himself, and orders a combined attack from his {{p|Marowak}}, {{p|Persian}}, and {{p|Paras}}. With Yellow kept at bay Miles escapes into the city, and as Erika struggles to get up Yellow decides to attack at full force as well. Much to Erika's dismay Yellow's full force merely consists of [[Ratty]] and [[Dody]], to which Yellow explains that he released all the other Pokémon he had captured, seeking only true friends as opposed to filling up [[Pokédex entry|Pokédex entries]]. As Yellow leaves on Dody, Erika orders one of her elite groups to follow, when she discovers the sketchbook Yellow has dropped. Flipping through the pages she finds detailed, annotated sketches of Yellow's three traveling companions. In the middle of Celadon City, Miles gloats to himself as Yellow struggles to find him in the dark. Musing to himself of the pay he would receive from the [[Agatha|old woman]] who ordered Pika's capture, and the prospects of experimenting on a [[Pokémon League]] champion's Pokémon, Miles swears revenge on the [[Celadon University]] he was kicked out of and plans his attack. As Yellow carefully searches, Marowak sends its {{m|Bonemerang}} to attack Yellow's team, while Yellow's attempts to listen for the Bonemerang are foiled as Persian uses {{m|Screech}} to create interfering noise. With Paras's {{m|Spore}} on Marowak's bone Yellow's team is slowly weakened, and a scream from Yellow elicits concern from Pika. As Erika gets to her feet, she deduces that Miles must have found Red in order to use the latter's scent in engineering his bodysuit, and at this revelation her citizens suggest that Professor Oak be consulted. However, Erika proposes an alternative in {{adv|Blaine}}: the fourth of the 'good' [[Gym Leader]]s who had once sworn allegiance with [[Team Rocket]], and so the scientist is contacted at his Gym on [[Cinnabar Island]]. ==Major events== * [[Pika]] gets taken away by {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}}. * It is revealed that {{adv|Yellow}}'s {{p|Seadra}}, along with other Pokémon, were released shortly after Yellow captured them. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Persian}} * {{p|Paras}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (flashback) * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} (flashback) * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Brock]] (fantasy) * [[Misty]] (fantasy) * [[Erika]] * [[Agatha]] (flashback) * {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} * [[Team Rocket]] scientist (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pidgeot}} ({{adv|Blue}}'s) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{adv|Blaine}}'s) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{adv|Mewtwo|Blaine's}}) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Gyara]]; [[Misty]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Marowak}} ({{adv|Miles}}'s) * {{p|Persian}} ({{adv|Miles}}'s) * {{p|Paras}} ({{adv|Miles}}'s) ==Trivia== * This chapter's name is a pun in one of the featured Pokémon {{p|Persian}}. ===Errors=== ===Translation edits=== * In the original Japanese version, the scratching noises produced by {{p|Persian}} are identified as {{m|Screech}}.
